text: [Photograph: Collage of advertisements and notices, including a "SAVOY COLLEGE" advertisement established 1876, listing faculty, departments, apparatus, and library sections; a "TEXAS EAGLE" notice; a "J. L. GOBER" advertisement; an "A. P. VOTH" advertisement; and a "MESSENGER" advertisement. Text in the advertisements is partially legible but too small and faded to transcribe verbatim.]
notes: Page 91 of printed book. Full-page photographic collage of newspaper advertisements. The Savoy College ad prominently features 'Established 1876' and lists course offerings, apparatus, and library. Individual text is too small and degraded to transcribe verbatim.
